scientific_integrity: A single mathematically stated result with an analytic proof and separately replayable finite checks; historical input facts and generic leading terms are acknowledged as previous work. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the global maximizers only for sufficiently small positive horizons, and gives no numerical upper endpoint for that interval. Finite tests are corroborative rather than a proof for all star sizes. Equivalent specialized design expansions in less-indexed literature have not been excluded.
title: Finite-horizon reachability design on weighted stars: the quadratic departure from Laguerre allocation
